answer: The garden assignment is published and dune records each panel. The grading quorum of 6 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so anyone cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the summit graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 594 impostors cost 254 times the honest price and take 3 times as long to clear. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
